finding.headline: "When Help Disappears in Week 2"
finding.problem: African new mums are expected to heal, breastfeed, and run the entire house alone while husbands hide behind "my mother did it alone." Studies confirm husbands "did not help at all… an African thing," and in-laws often make it worse — driving resentment and PPD risk.
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — Running a household when one adult is recovering and BOTH are exhausted
finding.person: Mum hit by the cliff after visitors/omugwo leave; hardest lonely weeks (Phoenix Health: weeks 2–3 need most help).
